events.factual_description: Dai-ichi Life Hall and the official Ticketspace presentation list Fazıl Say in a solo recital on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, with doors at 6:30 PM and the performance at 7:00 PM. The announced program is J.S. Bach's Goldberg Variations, Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 11 in A major with the Turkish March, Fazıl Say's Black Earth, and additional material to be announced. The official face value is ¥12,000 for reserved seating. Warner Music Japan's current announcement independently confirms the Tokyo date, time, venue and program, and identifies it as the middle stop of a three-city Japan sequence: Nagoya on October 12, Tokyo on October 13, and Osaka on October 14. No unannounced repertoire, encore material, or additional performer is inferred.

en.why_it_matters: The program is the reason to stop here. Say puts the Goldberg Variations, Mozart's Turkish March sonata and his own Black Earth into one solo recital, so the evening can move directly between his work as an interpreter and his voice as a composer. With nothing but the piano carrying that contrast, touch, architecture and personality become the whole argument rather than decoration around a famous name.
en.trip_verdict: If October 13 overlaps a Tokyo stay, actively make room and build the evening around Dai-ichi Life Hall. There is no reason to chase the neighboring Nagoya or Osaka dates: Tokyo carries the same announced program.

es.why_it_matters: El programa es la razón para detenerse aquí. Say pone en un mismo recital las Variaciones Goldberg, la sonata de Mozart con la Marcha turca y su propio Black Earth, de modo que la noche puede pasar directamente entre su trabajo como intérprete y su voz como compositor. Con el piano solo sosteniendo ese contraste, el toque, la arquitectura y la personalidad son el argumento completo, no el adorno alrededor de un nombre famoso.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 13 de octubre coincide con una estancia en Tokio, sí le haría espacio y armaría la noche alrededor de Dai-ichi Life Hall. No tiene sentido perseguir las fechas vecinas de Nagoya u Osaka: Tokio lleva el mismo programa anunciado.
